description: Screenshots a URL on simulated devices without any browser window or the extension, using Playwright with real device emulation (viewport, pixel ratio, touch, mobile mode, user agent). Safari devices render in WebKit, the others in Chromium. The page can be set up first: dark mode, hidden elements, extra CSS, and steps such as clicks; selectors are Playwright selectors. 'device' and 'screen' images have a transparent background. Pages behind a login need storage_state.

actions.description: Steps run in order after load and before capture, e.g. open a menu, fill a field or hover a button

selector.description: Element to focus first; omit to press on the page
Waits until this element is visible

color_scheme.description: prefers-color-scheme the page sees; omit for the browser default (light)

css.description: Extra CSS injected into the page before capture

browser.description: Browser UI and user agent to emulate. Defaults to Safari on Apple devices, Chrome on Android.

frame.description: viewport mode only: false uses the whole screen as the page instead of leaving room for status and browser bars

full_page.description: viewport mode only: capture the full scrollable page

hide.description: CSS selectors to hide before capture, e.g. cookie banners or chat widgets

max_width.description: Images are rendered at most this wide (and at most at the device's pixel ratio)

mode.description: device: with bezel and stand; screen: display with status and browser bars; viewport: the web page only

reduced_motion.description: prefers-reduced-motion the page sees; 'reduce' settles many animations before capture

save_dir.description: Also write the PNGs to this directory and return their paths

selector.description: Selector (CSS, or Playwright extras such as :visible and :has-text()) of an element. viewport mode captures only that element; device and screen modes scroll it to the top of the screen

storage_state.description: Path to a Playwright storage-state JSON (cookies and localStorage) for signed-in pages

wait_ms.description: Extra time after load, for animations and late content

name: view_sim_headless_screenshot
title: Headless screenshot
